_comment: wp_appdev — keyless app-store DEVELOPER lookup: a Google Play package name, or an Apple App Store numeric id / bundle id, resolved to the developer account behind it (display name, legal name, contact email, website, the account's other apps). Endpoint templates, the fetch profile, the Play page labels the parser anchors on, and the hosts that are never a developer's own website live here (RULE 3) so a store markup or label change is a data edit, not a code change. `{id}` / `{country}` are URL-encoded by the caller before substitution. Nothing here is case data — these are public store hostnames and generic store vocabulary.

settings._comment: ua is an Android Chrome string (project decision: prefer an Android UA for web requests); timeout_seconds is the socket timeout per store fetch; max_other_apps caps the developer's other-apps list returned; country is the default iTunes storefront; lookup_countries are tried in order until one knows the app id (an app sold only in some storefronts answers resultCount 0 elsewhere); eu_storefronts are English EU App Store storefronts tried in order for the product page that carries the EU Digital Services Act trader block (empty list = skip that fetch); about_block_max bounds how many text nodes after the Play 'About the developer' heading are read as that block.
settings.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Pixel 8) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

endpoints._comment: Keyless store endpoints. play_details = the app's public listing page; play_base is joined to the developer-page href the listing links to (/store/apps/dev?id=… or /store/apps/developer?id=…) to list the account's other apps; itunes_lookup_id / itunes_lookup_bundle resolve an App Store numeric id / bundle id; itunes_artist_apps lists every app under the artistId (the developer account).

play_labels._comment: English Play listing labels (the page is fetched with hl=en). about_developer heads the developer-identity block: legal name, email, postal address, phone (each optional, typed per node); website labels the developer website link; email labels the contact email. block_end headings (prefix match) and the node before a section_icon glyph end the About block. Compared case-insensitively against whole text nodes.

appstore_page._comment: apps.apple.com product page, English EU storefront. Its <script id=serialized-server-data> JSON carries an Annotation titled by provider_titles whose rawText items state whether the provider declared itself a TRADER under the EU Digital Services Act (trader_declared / trader_not_declared sentence fragments, matched case-insensitively; not_declared is checked first) and, when declared, '**Label**\nvalue' markdown fields mapped by trader_fields. Apple DISPLAYS these values but they are self-declared by the developer. ProductPageLink items whose text matches link_labels give the listing's website / support / privacy-policy URLs. own_shelves scopes both reads to the REQUESTED product's own shelves (shelfMapping key AND contentType must both match): the same page embeds similar apps whose lockups carry other developers' links, so a page-wide scan would read another developer's data. The page intent id must also equal the requested track id.

trader_declared: has identified itself as a trader
trader_not_declared: has not identified itself as a trader

noise_hosts._comment: Registrable domains that are never a developer's own website or mailbox domain — the store's own chrome, policy and support links that every listing carries. A link or email on one of these is skipped, never reported as the developer's.

rung_classes._comment: Rung classes (tools/kb/references/rungs.json) this tool stamps on its rows. developer_url is set ONLY when the developer website's registrable domain equals a case domain — then it is an owner link; an unmatched website or the developer email is a seed CANDIDATE, never auto-seeded.
